population_banner:
POPULATION: this projection covers 68 declared ET-CC members and 39
declared in-population OC checks. That is the slice adjudicated so far,
and it is NOT the whole conformance picture: the full comparison is 281
ET-CC members and 173 in-denominator OC checks, of which 213 members and
120 checks are not_yet_adjudicated -- a third state, distinct from
bucket 1 -- owned by the tickets the crosswalk's own
`outside_the_population` block names. A further 14 checks carry an edge
without being declared by any file, so they are counted in neither.

A count of zero in this view means zero WITHIN THAT SLICE. It does not
mean zero in the suite. As the declared population grows this projection
re-runs and fills.

none is written here. The [population_statement] guard refuses a
population figure that is not.
